reviews.comment: He's the GOAT. Not much else to say...
Dr. Leonard is a great guy! He's very laid back in class and made a good environment for discussion. It's important to actually read the books, but it's not too much reading. Really nice and funny.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Love him!! I was nervous bc i don'y particpate too much and am more shy. But he was very accommodating and he did not grade too hard. Also not to glaze him, but he is very funny lol. You will have to read quite a few books but they are interesting and i feel that i genuinely enjoyed the discussions. Attendance is mandatory but you get 4 absences.

Professor Leonard is very engaging and creates an interactive environment! The course includes biweekly quizzes on the readings which help with staying on track. I found the feedback on the writing to be constructive and helpful for my progress. Participation and attendance are key components of the grading style.

I am an English major, and Dr. Leonard is one of the best English professors I have ever taken. He encourages discussion, so be prepared to do all of the readings, but he keeps everything constantly engaging. You can tell he is truly excited about what he does, and I cannot recommend him enough.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Grade was based on three papers, quizzes, attendance, and a final. Lectures were engaging and interesting, and his grading was not too harsh. Overall, a chill guy who cares for his students and their success. He can be a bit disorganized but can't recommend him enough, to both English and non-English majors!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He's genuinely so awesome. He's clearly very passionate about the material and literature in general and will passionately yap with you. He gives very detailed and constructive feedback while being very supportive of using your creativity. Very inspirational on thinking about things beyond surface level, think Robin Williams in Dead Poets Society.

He's a great guy who genuinely cares about his students. He is funny and his lectures are engaging. Grading was 3 essays which he grades generously, and a final, you get a 2 paged sheet to write notes. There are quizzes but they are all pass fail and as long as you read the texts, youll pass. Attendence is mandatory but its worth it to go to class
